system.description: For reasons unknown to you or your sire, your Embrace left the imprint of a third eye upon your forehead — a mocking reminder of Tremere's diablerie of Saulot. It renders you both an embarrassment to your own clan and a figure of suspicion to everyone else, since it invites obvious (if unwelcome) comparison to the Salubri. The eye does not open or function. Unless concealed under a hood or hair, the stigma is plain to all who see you, imposing a +2 difficulty on Social rolls with any Cainite outside your coterie or closest allies. Attempting to pass yourself off as a Salubri is, unsurprisingly, not advisable.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers (Tremere)
